title: PULP register_interface
_note: PULP's register_interface: the `reg_bus` protocol and every bridge around it
-- APB / AXI-Lite / AXI / periph / TileLink / memory converters in both
directions, plus the fabric pieces (reg_mux, reg_demux, reg_cut, reg_cdc,
reg_uniform, reg_filter_empty_writes, reg_err_slv).  Only its own src/ is
swept; axi, apb and common_cells are closure-only and have their own
families.
src/deprecated and src/test are not sources: the first holds the superseded
v1 bridges, the second the verification components.
EVERY row skips without a bind: all 19 modules take their bus as
`parameter type req_t = logic`, so at their defaults member access on it is
invalid and the family measures NOTHING.  Binding is the whole exercise here,
not a refinement.
The prelude carries ONLY register_interface/typedef.svh and plain logic
typedefs, and that limit is deliberate: axi/typedef.svh makes 21 references
to `axi_pkg` and apb/typedef.svh one to `apb_pkg`, and a prelude is shared by
EVERY wrapper in the family -- so naming either package would fail every row
whose closure has no axi or apb in it (cheshire.json records the same trap
with iDMA).  register_interface/typedef.svh references no package at all.
So the four bridge rows that genuinely need a foreign bus type -- the AXI,
AXI-Lite and APB converters -- plus reg_to_tlul, whose TileLink types live in
OpenTitan's tlul_pkg and not in this repository at all, DECLINE to bind (a
null mapping) and stay honest skips.  Inventing those structs would mean
measuring a netlist built from a shape nobody verified.
common_cells/src/deprecated is a closure root as well: reg_cdc and its
src / dst halves instantiate `cdc_2phase_src` / `cdc_2phase_dst`, which live
only there, and a non-recursive `src/*.sv` glob left three rows reporting
`unknown module`.  Checked first that it introduces no DUPLICATE definition
-- the module names in src/ and src/deprecated/ do not intersect -- because
core-v-mcu.json records the opposite case, where three flavours of the same
vendored cells collide.
tech_cells_generic is a closure root too, for `tc_sync`: without it reg_cdc
and its src / dst halves read fine but read_slang stops at
`unknown module 'tc_sync'`, so the rows had no REFERENCE and could not be
compared.  Only the generic src/rtl flavour is taken -- core-v-mcu.json
records what happens when the fpga / deprecated flavours come along too.
First local sweep 2026-10-29: of 19 rows, **11 comparable and 11 / 11
proven**, 11 co-sim PASS, 11 / 11 with 0 undriven, 0 `read_uhdm`
divergences.  The 8 that remain are the honest skips above -- the AXI,
AXI-Lite and APB bridges, reg_to_tlul, and reg_to_mem / reg_uniform /
apb_to_reg_intf / axi_lite_to_reg_intf, whose remaining type parameters have
no shape a shared prelude can give them.
